capabilities: present any note as fullscreen slides without special syntax
auto-split notes by dividers or the shallowest repeated heading level
split overflowing sections into continuation slides and scale content to fit
annotate slides with laser pointer, pen and highlighter
start a presentation from the cursor position
extras: Install requires BRAT or manual copy of release files; releases include GitHub artifact attestations for verifying the build source.
intentEvidence: 功能强大，但需要按它们的格式写幻灯片。Podium 面向「现成的笔记直接讲」。
problem: Existing presentation plugins and Obsidian's built-in Slides require special syntax or a fixed heading level, so an already-written note cannot simply be presented.
